sources.title: NASA · 什么是系外行星
sources.excerpt: 系外行星包括环绕其他恒星的世界；它们的大小、温度与轨道各不相同，也存在不绕恒星运行的流浪行星。
sources.excerpt_en: Exoplanets include worlds orbiting other stars, with varied sizes, temperatures, and orbits; rogue planets do not orbit a star.
sources.summary: 系外行星包括环绕其他恒星的世界；它们的大小、温度与轨道各不相同，也存在不绕恒星运行的流浪行星。
sources.summary_en: Exoplanets include worlds orbiting other stars, with varied sizes, temperatures, and orbits; rogue planets do not orbit a star.

sources.title: NASA · 什么是光年
sources.excerpt: 光年衡量光在一年中传播的距离，约为 9.46 万亿千米。这里只采用单位解释，不沿用页面中的旧发现总数。
sources.excerpt_en: A light-year measures how far light travels in one year: about 9.46 trillion kilometers. This sample uses the unit explanation, not the page’s older discovery totals.
sources.summary: 光年衡量光在一年中传播的距离，约为 9.46 万亿千米。这里只采用单位解释，不沿用页面中的旧发现总数。
sources.summary_en: A light-year measures how far light travels in one year: about 9.46 trillion kilometers. This sample uses the unit explanation, not the page’s older discovery totals.

sources.title: NASA · 如何寻找与刻画系外行星
sources.title_en: NASA · How we find and characterize
sources.excerpt: 凌日法寻找行星经过恒星前方时造成的微小亮度下降。结合轨道周期和恒星质量，可推算轨道尺度。
sources.excerpt_en: The transit method detects small dips in starlight as a planet crosses in front of its star. Orbital period and stellar mass help determine orbital scale.
sources.summary: 凌日法寻找行星经过恒星前方时造成的微小亮度下降。结合轨道周期和恒星质量，可推算轨道尺度。
sources.summary_en: The transit method detects small dips in starlight as a planet crosses in front of its star. Orbital period and stellar mass help determine orbital scale.

sources.title: ESA/Webb · 光谱仪与光谱学
sources.excerpt: 光谱仪把光按波长展开；光谱特征帮助研究物质成分。Webb 的四台科学仪器均具有光谱观测能力。
sources.excerpt_en: Spectrographs disperse light by wavelength. Spectral features help study composition, and all four Webb science instruments have spectroscopic capabilities.
sources.summary: 光谱仪把光按波长展开；光谱特征帮助研究物质成分。Webb 的四台科学仪器均具有光谱观测能力。
sources.summary_en: Spectrographs disperse light by wavelength. Spectral features help study composition, and all four Webb science instruments have spectroscopic capabilities.

sources.title: NASA · Webb 科学主题
sources.excerpt: Webb 的四个主要科学主题为早期宇宙、星系演化、恒星生命周期和其他世界。
sources.excerpt_en: Webb’s four main science themes are the early universe, galaxies over time, the star lifecycle, and other worlds.
sources.summary: Webb 的四个主要科学主题为早期宇宙、星系演化、恒星生命周期和其他世界。
sources.summary_en: Webb’s four main science themes are the early universe, galaxies over time, the star lifecycle, and other worlds.

sources.title: NASA · Webb 如何研究系外行星
sources.excerpt: 透射光谱比较凌日期间与恒星本身的光谱，寻找行星大气对特定波长光的吸收，并与分子参考特征比对。
sources.excerpt_en: Transmission spectroscopy compares light during a transit with the star alone, looking for wavelength-specific absorption and comparing it with molecular reference signatures.
sources.summary: 透射光谱比较凌日期间与恒星本身的光谱，寻找行星大气对特定波长光的吸收，并与分子参考特征比对。
sources.summary_en: Transmission spectroscopy compares light during a transit with the star alone, looking for wavelength-specific absorption and comparing it with molecular reference signatures.

sources.title: NASA · GJ 486 b 的透射光谱
sources.excerpt: 这张 2023 年公布的光谱案例存在两种解释：富水行星大气或宿主恒星的星斑；页面说明还需额外波段观测。
sources.excerpt_en: This spectrum released in 2023 has two possible explanations: a water-rich planetary atmosphere or host-star spots. The source calls for observations at additional wavelengths.
sources.summary: 这张 2023 年公布的光谱案例存在两种解释：富水行星大气或宿主恒星的星斑；页面说明还需额外波段观测。

claims.title: 先从太阳系以外的世界开始
claims.title_en: Begin with worlds beyond our solar system
claims.text: 环绕其他恒星运行的行星属于系外行星；该概念也包含不围绕恒星运行的流浪行星。
claims.text_en: Planets orbiting other stars are exoplanets; the category also includes rogue planets that do not orbit a star.
claims.statement: 环绕其他恒星运行的行星属于系外行星；该概念也包含不围绕恒星运行的流浪行星。
claims.statement_en: Planets orbiting other stars are exoplanets; the category also includes rogue planets that do not orbit a star.

claims.title: 系外行星并不都像地球
claims.text: 系外行星涵盖比木星更大的气态巨行星与接近地球大小的岩石世界，温度和轨道也有很大差异。
claims.text_en: Exoplanets range from gas giants larger than Jupiter to rocky worlds near Earth’s size, with widely differing temperatures and orbits.
claims.statement: 系外行星涵盖比木星更大的气态巨行星与接近地球大小的岩石世界，温度和轨道也有很大差异。
claims.statement_en: Exoplanets range from gas giants larger than Jupiter to rocky worlds near Earth’s size, with widely differing temperatures and orbits.

claims.title: 光年是距离单位
claims.title_en: A light-year is a unit of distance
claims.text: 光年表示光在一年中传播的距离，因此它是距离单位，不是时间单位。
claims.text_en: A light-year is the distance light travels in one year, so it is a unit of distance rather than time.
claims.statement: 光年表示光在一年中传播的距离，因此它是距离单位，不是时间单位。
claims.statement_en: A light-year is the distance light travels in one year, so it is a unit of distance rather than time.

claims.title: 一光年约为 9.46 万亿千米
claims.title_en: One light-year is about 9.46 trillion km
claims.text: NASA 的科普页将一光年近似表示为 9.46 万亿千米；这里的数值用于理解数量级。
claims.text_en: NASA’s explainer gives approximately 9.46 trillion kilometers per light-year; this rounded value conveys the scale.
claims.statement: NASA 的科普页将一光年近似表示为 9.46 万亿千米；这里的数值用于理解数量级。
claims.statement_en: NASA’s explainer gives approximately 9.46 trillion kilometers per light-year; this rounded value conveys the scale.

claims.title: 从亮度下降寻找凌日
claims.title_en: Look for a dip in starlight
claims.text: 当行星从我们视线方向经过恒星前方，会遮挡少量恒星光。凌日法寻找这种微小亮度下降。
claims.text_en: When a planet passes in front of a star along our line of sight, it blocks a little starlight. The transit method looks for this small brightness dip.
claims.statement: 当行星从我们视线方向经过恒星前方，会遮挡少量恒星光。凌日法寻找这种微小亮度下降。
claims.statement_en: When a planet passes in front of a star along our line of sight, it blocks a little starlight. The transit method looks for this small brightness dip.

claims.title: 周期是解释轨道的线索
claims.text: 凌日观测可提供轨道周期；结合恒星质量，可以计算行星轨道的尺度。此样例没有执行观测拟合。
claims.text_en: Transit observations can provide an orbital period. Together with stellar mass, this constrains orbital scale. This sample does not fit observations.
claims.statement: 凌日观测可提供轨道周期；结合恒星质量，可以计算行星轨道的尺度。此样例没有执行观测拟合。
claims.statement_en: Transit observations can provide an orbital period. Together with stellar mass, this constrains orbital scale. This sample does not fit observations.

claims.title: 光谱将颜色变成成分线索
claims.text: 光谱仪把光分解成不同波长，科学家根据光谱模式分析原子与分子的特征。
claims.text_en: A spectrograph separates light into wavelengths. Scientists analyze spectral patterns for signatures of atoms and molecules.
claims.statement: 光谱仪把光分解成不同波长，科学家根据光谱模式分析原子与分子的特征。
claims.statement_en: A spectrograph separates light into wavelengths. Scientists analyze spectral patterns for signatures of atoms and molecules.

claims.title: 相同信号可以有不同解释
claims.title_en: A signal can have competing explanations
claims.text: 在 2023 年公布的 GJ 486 b 案例中，水蒸气线索既可能来自行星大气，也可能来自恒星星斑。这份历史材料不能单独确证行星大气；应保留替代解释与后续观测需求。
claims.text_en: In the GJ 486 b case released in 2023, hints of water vapor could come from a planetary atmosphere or stellar spots. This historical evidence alone does not establish a planetary atmosphere; competing explanations and the need for follow-up remain explicit.
claims.statement: 在 2023 年公布的 GJ 486 b 案例中，水蒸气线索既可能来自行星大气，也可能来自恒星星斑。这份历史材料不能单独确证行星大气；应保留替代解释与后续观测需求。
claims.statement_en: In the GJ 486 b case released in 2023, hints of water vapor could come from a planetary atmosphere or stellar spots. This historical evidence alone does not establish a planetary atmosphere; competing explanations and the need for follow-up remain explicit.

claims.title: Webb 连接四个科学主题
claims.text: Webb 的主要科学主题覆盖早期宇宙、星系演化、恒星生命周期，以及系外行星等其他世界。
claims.text_en: Webb’s main themes cover the early universe, galaxy evolution, the star lifecycle, and other worlds such as exoplanets.
claims.statement: Webb 的主要科学主题覆盖早期宇宙、星系演化、恒星生命周期，以及系外行星等其他世界。
claims.statement_en: Webb’s main themes cover the early universe, galaxy evolution, the star lifecycle, and other worlds such as exoplanets.

claims.title: 用透射光谱探索大气
claims.text: Webb 可以比较凌日时与恒星本身的光谱，分析哪些波长被吸收，再与分子参考特征比对。这是大气研究的方法，不自动构成生命存在的证明。
claims.text_en: Webb can compare transit spectra with the star alone, identify absorbed wavelengths, and compare them with molecular references. This is a method for studying atmospheres, not automatic proof of life.
claims.statement: Webb 可以比较凌日时与恒星本身的光谱，分析哪些波长被吸收，再与分子参考特征比对。这是大气研究的方法，不自动构成生命存在的证明。
claims.statement_en: Webb can compare transit spectra with the star alone, identify absorbed wavelengths, and compare them with molecular references. This is a method for studying atmospheres, not automatic proof of life.
